QuestInfo.name: The Strange Lives of Ghost Stumps
QuestInfo.0: Winston has been studying the bizarre Ghost Stumps in his spare time, and needs some help. See what he needs.
QuestInfo.1: Winston needs samples for his Ghost Stump research. Go to #bGusty Peak#k and eliminate #r30 Smiling Ghost Stumps and 30 Ghost Stumps#k, and collect #b30 #t4000195#s#k.
QuestInfo.2: You brought all the necessary research materials to Winston.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 586 \n#Wbasic# \n#i2030003:# #t2030003:# x 10 Can proceed to the Excavation Report quest

0.0: We've fallen upon dark times, chum. The Smiling Ghost Stumps have begun menacing us, and I need to learn more about them. You'll help me out, yes?

yes.0: Magnificent! I need Ghost Stump samples to examine. Scamper up to #bGusty Peak#k, eliminate 30 Ghost Stumps and Smiling Ghost Stumps each, and bring back #b30 #t4000195#s#k.

no.0: Goodness, but this threatens all of us! Have you any idea how dangerous haunted chunks of wood can be? Horrifying!

yes.0: Good work, this should be enough. Not sure why they're acting up, but this is a good start.

default.0: I say, this is no time to dawdle! Or dilly-dally! Eliminate 30 Ghost Stumps and Smiling Ghost Stumps each, and return with 30 #t4000195#s.
